Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
6:09 AM

Raja, a young tiger from the Sundarbans, was bored of raw fish and plain old deer. One monsoon night he crept close to a boatman's camp and watched a pot bubble over the fire, steam rising with cardamom, saffron and fried onions. He licked his whiskers and made up his mind: he would cook that golden rice himself.

It went badly at first. He chopped onions and cried so loudly that the crocodiles came to check on him. He forgot the water and turned the rice into black pebbles, then added so much salt that even the crabs spat it out. Each morning he scrubbed his pot in the river and started over, sniffing every spice until he knew them all by smell.

Then one evening he got it right: long soft grains, tender masala, a lid sealed with dough and opened slowly. The smell floated through the mangroves, and soon deer, monkeys and one very nervous boatman sat in a circle around his fire. Raja served everyone a full leaf plate, and from that day nobody in the forest ran from the tiger. They only asked what time dinner was. 🐯

Here are 5 tips to sleep better:

Sleep and wake at the same time every day, weekends too.
Put your phone away 30 minutes before bed.
Skip tea and coffee after 3:00 PM.
Keep your room dark, cool and quiet.
Eat a light dinner at least 2 hours before sleeping.
